# windsurf-oauth-opencode

OpenCode plugin for Windsurf browser auth and cloud model access through a local OpenAI-compatible proxy.

## Install

```sh
npx windsurf-oauth-opencode setup --global
opencode auth login --provider windsurf
```

The setup command patches OpenCode config so the `windsurf` provider is visible. Login stores auth through OpenCode, and model requests are routed through a local proxy to Windsurf's cloud transport.
